column1: # 03_Grading MACHINE_PATHS (H2, 30 Oct 2026): every machine path in the files of MANIFEST.tsv (each tree/ file scanned for /Users/, /Volumes/, /home/,
# /mnt/, /sessions/, ~/ and $HOME, plus the paths a line builds from F, R, T, L2, AP). The top copies month_parts/*.md
# (byte copies) and the tree/ README, SCOPE, ARCHITECTURE, REQUIREMENTS, BASELINE and the two tests name no absolute machine path.
# kind DATA, SCRATCH, CODE, PYTHON. status ARG (an argument: fine), BUILT_IN (a new edition must read it from the settings file or take
# it from inside Alarm), TEXT (only in a header line or a document). settings_key: the keys of Alarm/settings/SETTINGS_EXAMPLE.env.
# The GRADE job template and PROCESS_V7 moved with the kit to Alarm/Agentic (30 Oct): their rows are in ../Agentic/MACHINE_PATHS.tsv.

column5: what
PY: the interpreter every step runs with
F, the dev forensics root (R=$F/team/RESEARCH, T=$R/tools, L2=$R/LEAD/loop2): every step tool and table below is taken from the dev tree by absolute path; they are TEST editions, not in Alarm
ROSTER, the 52-coin table: read by the chain for the coin parts and passed to detect and grade as --roster; not in Alarm
G, the menu settings (Outcomes labels, race grid): the 4th argument; this dev file when it is absent
METRIC_TRAPS (env): the metric table the reading gate inside detect checks
CATALOGS (env): the 4 metric catalogs detect reads
